items.title: ICRA Q1 Results: Profit rises 32% YoY to Rs 56 crore
items.description: ICRA Ltd reported a 32 percent net profit increase for the first quarter.  Revenue from operations also saw a significant 31.2 percent year-on-year rise.  Healthy growth in ratings and sustained momentum in risk and analytics supported performance.  Demand in industries and NBFC segments drove ratings revenue growth.  Risk and analytics benefited from robust demand for technology-led solutions.

items.title: Bajaj Finance posts 28% growth in net profit amid healthy loan demand
items.description: Bajaj Finance reported a 28% year-on-year net profit increase for the June quarter.  Assets under management climbed 24% to ₹5.47 lakh crore as of June-end.  The company added 5.1 million new customers during the quarter.  Net interest income rose 23% and net total income increased 22%.  Bajaj Finance expects to disburse 60-62 million new loans in FY27.

items.title: Bajaj Finserv Q1 Results: Net profit rises 12% YoY to Rs 3,132 crore; shares rally 5%
items.description: Bajaj Finserv announced a twelve percent rise in net profit for the first quarter.  The company's revenue from operations also increased nineteen percent year-on-year.  Interest income saw a rise of over eighteen percent during the same period.  These positive financial results pushed the company's shares higher by more than five percent.  The reported figures reflect strong performance in the initial quarter of fiscal year twenty twenty-seven.

items.title: Sun Pharma Q1 Results: Profit rises 27% YoY to Rs 2,895 crore; revenue climbs 10.5%
items.description: Sun Pharma Q1 Results: Sun Pharma reported a 27% YoY rise in Q1 net profit to Rs 2,895 crore, while revenue grew 10% to Rs 15,300 crore, driven by strong performance in India and its innovative medicines business despite weak US formulations sales. EBITDA rose 3% to Rs 4,418 crore. The company highlighted semaglutide approvals and said the Organon acquisition remains on track for early 2027.

items.title: ITC Q1 Results: Standalone profit falls 27% YoY to Rs 3,579 crore, but revenue grows 28%
items.description: ITC's net profit declined twenty-seven percent year-on-year for the first quarter.  Revenue from operations, however, saw a significant twenty-eight percent increase during the same period.  This financial performance covers the April to June quarter of the fiscal year twenty twenty-seven.  The company's standalone net profit stood at rupees three thousand five hundred seventy-nine crore.  Revenue from operations reached rupees twenty-six thousand nine hundred forty-three crore for the quarter.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki Q1 Results: Profit falls 11% YoY to Rs 3,352 crore; revenue rises 36%
items.description: Maruti Suzuki reported an 11% year-on-year decline in Q1 standalone net profit to Rs 3,352 crore despite a 36% rise in revenue, as higher material costs weighed on earnings. Strong growth in SUV sales, exports and market share lifted volumes, while the board approved Rs 561 crore for biogas projects.

items.title: Urban Company Q1 Results: Firm posts Rs 92 crore loss vs profit year ago; revenue rises 44% YoY
items.description: Urban Company slipped to a Rs 92 crore net loss in Q1 FY27 despite a 44% year-on-year rise in revenue to Rs 528 crore, as aggressive expansion of its InstaHelp business weighed on profitability. The company, however, reported strong growth across its core India, international and Native businesses.

items.title: Maruti Suzuki Q1 profit drops 11% YoY to Rs 3,352 crore on higher input costs
items.description: Maruti Suzuki reported an 11% year-on-year decline in Q1 consolidated net profit to Rs 3,352 crore, missing estimates as higher input costs linked to the West Asia crisis squeezed margins. Revenue and sales volumes grew strongly, while the company approved Rs 561 crore for four compressed biogas projects.

items.title: Aditya Birla Capital Q1 Results: Profit jumps 40% YoY to Rs 1,175 crore
items.description: Aditya Birla Capital has announced an impressive forty percent increase in profits for the first quarter. The company’s consolidated total income reflects a substantial rise when compared to the same time last year. Additionally, there have been significant advancements in their lending portfolio, assets under management, and life and health insurance premiums, all showcasing notable year-on-year growth. To fuel its future growth ambitions, the firm successfully raised significant equity capital.

items.title: IOC slips into loss in Q1 on holding fuel prices despite rise in cost
items.description: Indian Oil Corporation reported losses for the June quarter that were lower than analysts expected. This was largely due to efficiency improvements and higher margins from refining. The company celebrated record highs in crude throughput and a drop in fuel losses, with petrol and diesel sales reaching impressive quarterly figures. Moreover, IOC successfully secured crude oil from multiple global sources, mitigating any supply disruptions.
